common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

landing.title: circloo · your circle's fridge door
landing.wordmarkHint: The letters are magnets. Move them around.
landing.headline: The fridge door for your people.
landing.sub: Check in on how everyone feels, start meetings with a laugh and decide things together. One small private space for your family, your friends or your team.
landing.languagesLine: Speaks English, français, العربية and español.
landing.ctaSecondary: See what goes on the door

teaser.title: Today's icebreaker
teaser.answerHint: Stays on your screen. Nothing is sent.
teaser.error: The card slipped behind the fridge. Shake again.

feel.title: Feel together
feel.body: One tap in the morning tells your circle how you are. Words and faces, never just colours. A note or a small need if you want, and that is it.
feel.weather: Circle weather: mostly bright, one person needs coffee.

work.title: Work together
work.body: Live boards for brainstorms, retros and decisions. Stick notes, drag them, vote with dots, watch everyone's cursor move. On a phone or on the big screen.

fun.title: Have fun together
fun.body: Icebreakers, riddles and jokes written by people in each language, not translated by a machine. Kind humour only. AI suggests fresh ones that fit your circle.

integrations.title: Plugs into your week
integrations.body: circloo will meet you where you already work. These are on the way, not ready yet.

items.teams: Start Teams meetings with an icebreaker
items.salesforce: Celebrate the deals your team wins
items.confluence: Publish a board as a page
items.notion: Send boards and notes to your workspace

steps.title: Type your email
steps.body: We send you a six-digit code. No password to remember.

steps.title: Make your circle
steps.body: Family, friends or team. Invite people by email or with a simple code.

steps.title: Stick things on the door
steps.body: Check-ins, icebreakers and boards, all in one place.

final.title: Your circle is waiting by the fridge.
final.body: Private by default. Only the people you invite can see what is on your door.

footer.made: Made for families, friends and teams in four languages.

auth.title: Sign in or join
auth.lead: Just your email. We send you a code, no password.
auth.neutral: If this address can receive email, a code is on its way.
auth.codeLead: Type the six-digit code we sent to <email>{{email}}</email>.

errors.invalidEmail: This email address does not look right. Please check it.
errors.invalidCode: That code does not work. It may be wrong, already used or expired.
errors.rateLimited: Slow down a little. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.generic: We could not reach circloo. Check your connection and try again.

welcome.title: Hello, my name is
welcome.lead: This is how your circle will see you.
welcome.namePlaceholder: Write your name on the line
welcome.nameHelp: 1 to 40 characters. You can change it later.

errors.name: Please write a name between 1 and 40 characters.

home.lead: Your door is ready. Here is what we are sticking on it next.

icebreakers.title: Icebreakers
icebreakers.body: Fresh questions and jokes for your circle, suggested by AI and checked for kindness.

checkins.title: Daily check-in
checkins.body: One tap to share your mood. See your circle's weather.

boards.title: Live boards
boards.body: Brainstorms, retros and votes with everyone at once.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Teams, Salesforce, Jira, Confluence and Notion.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sessionsBody: Signed in on a computer you no longer use? Sign out everywhere, including here.
settings.confirmEverywhere: Yes, sign out on every device

notFound.title: This note fell behind the fridge.
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or moved.
